name: graph_summary
author: 80ae2fd8
description: Summarizes a graph's structural properties, including node count, edge count, directedness, weighted status, density, and connected components. For connected, undirected, unweighted graphs, also reports diameter, radius, and average shortest-path length. Path metrics are returned as null for directed, weighted, or disconnected graphs under the current implementation.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse.
